Unofficial, temporary fix that makes CelesTech recipes show up in EMI again (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge).

**Install:** put the jar in your `mods` folder next to CelesTech, JEI and EMI. It is client-side only. Remove it once CelesTech ships an official fix; it also switches itself off when it is not needed.

Made for CelesTech 0.1.6-alpha (mod version 0.503), EMI 1.1.24+1.21.1 and JEI 19.64.0.455. The [README](https://github.com/anoubios/celestech-emi-fix#readme) explains what it changes and why.
